entries.en: She remained collected while the other passengers searched frantically for their tickets.
entries.zh: 其他乘客慌忙找票时，她仍然保持镇定。

entries.en: The union requested collective bargaining over the proposed changes to working hours.
entries.zh: 工会要求就拟议中的工时调整进行集体谈判。

entries.en: The worksheet asks students to identify the collective noun in each sentence.
entries.zh: 练习题要求学生找出每个句子中的集合名词。

entries.en: The museum displayed a rare collector's item as the centrepiece of the exhibition.
entries.zh: 博物馆把一件珍稀的收藏家藏品作为展览的核心展品展出。

entries.en: The corpus exercise explores which verbs collocate naturally with this noun.
entries.zh: 语料库练习探讨了哪些动词能与这个名词自然搭配。

entries.en: The historical case index includes a record of colonic irrigation.
entries.zh: 历史病例索引中有一条结肠灌洗记录。

entries.en: The newspaper's colour supplement featured photographs of the restored theatre.
entries.zh: 报纸的彩色增刊刊登了修复后剧院的照片。

entries.en: The children arranged coloured glass pieces around the window frame.
entries.zh: 孩子们沿着窗框摆放彩色玻璃片。

entries.en: The baker checked whether the icing contained artificial colouring.
entries.zh: 面包师检查了糖霜是否含有人造色素。

entries.en: He forgot the numbers for the combination lock on his suitcase.
entries.zh: 他忘记了行李箱暗码锁的密码。

entries.en: Their combined efforts brought the damaged boat back to shore.
entries.zh: 他们齐心协力，把受损的船带回了岸边。

entries.en: The dictionary marks the combining form with a hyphen.
entries.zh: 词典用连字符标示这个构词成分。

entries.en: The free dessert was a come-on to attract diners to the new restaurant.
entries.zh: 免费甜点是吸引食客到这家新餐厅的诱惑。

entries.en: Her comforting words helped him face the difficult interview.
entries.zh: 她安慰的话语帮助他面对这场艰难的面试。

entries.en: The comic strip ended with the missing dog returning home.
entries.zh: 这则连环漫画以走失的狗回家作结。

entries.en: The club will announce its plans during the coming week.
entries.zh: 俱乐部将在接下来的一周宣布计划。

entries.en: The historical map places the command post behind the ridge.
entries.zh: 历史地图将指挥所标在山脊后面。

entries.en: The ruined tower occupies a commanding position above the valley.
entries.zh: 废塔占据着山谷上方居高临下的位置。

entries.en: The local commercial bank moved into the restored corner building.
entries.zh: 当地商业银行搬进了修复后的街角大楼。

entries.en: The school relies on a committed group of volunteer tutors.
entries.zh: 这所学校依靠一群热心投入的志愿辅导教师。

entries.en: She missed the choir rehearsal because of a common cold.
entries.zh: 她因感冒缺席了合唱排练。

entries.en: The student found a common denominator before adding the fractions.
entries.zh: 学生先求出公分母，再把分数相加。

entries.en: The two architects found common ground in their concern for public spaces.
entries.zh: 两位建筑师在关心公共空间这一点上找到了共同点。

entries.en: The villagers grazed their sheep on common land beyond the stream.
entries.zh: 村民们在溪流另一边的公地上放羊。

entries.en: The teacher contrasted the common noun with the person's name.
entries.zh: 老师把这个普通名词与人名作了对比。

entries.en: Common sense told us to postpone the picnic until the storm passed.
entries.zh: 常识告诉我们，应把野餐推迟到暴风雨过后。

entries.en: The annual report lists the outstanding shares of common stock.
entries.zh: 年度报告列出了流通在外的普通股股数。

entries.en: In the play, the prince exchanges clothes with a commoner.
entries.zh: 在剧中，王子与一位平民交换衣服。

entries.en: The librarian found the recording on a compact disc in the archive.
entries.zh: 图书馆员在档案里的一张光盘上找到了这段录音。

entries.en: The grammar chapter examines complementation after verbs of perception.
entries.zh: 语法这一章研究了感知动词后的补足结构。

entries.en: The captain looked composed despite the crowd's anxious questions.
entries.zh: 尽管人群焦急地提问，船长看上去仍然沉着。

entries.en: The historical surgical atlas includes an illustration of a compound fracture.
entries.zh: 历史外科图谱中有一幅有创骨折的插图。

entries.en: The chemistry diagram contrasts compounded substances with their separate elements.
entries.zh: 化学示意图将化合物质与其各自的元素作了比较。

entries.en: The compressed bundles of cloth fitted into the narrow storage space.
entries.zh: 压缩后的布料包能放进狭窄的储物空间。

entries.en: Her compromising approach helped the divided committee reach an agreement.
entries.zh: 她愿意让步的做法帮助意见分歧的委员会达成了协议。

entries.en: The detective discovered that the charming visitor was a con artist.
entries.zh: 侦探发现，那位迷人的访客是个骗子。

entries.en: The concentrated beam of light illuminated a tiny patch on the wall.
entries.zh: 集中的光束照亮了墙上的一小块地方。

entries.en: The museum preserves letters written by prisoners in the concentration camp.
entries.zh: 博物馆保存着集中营囚犯写下的信件。

entries.en: The speaker saved her strongest point for the concluding paragraph.
entries.zh: 演讲者把最有力的论点留在了结尾段。

entries.en: The recipe calls for condensed milk and a little lemon juice.
entries.zh: 这份食谱需要炼乳和少量柠檬汁。

entries.en: The newspaper exposed a confidence trick involving worthless railway shares.
entries.zh: 报纸揭露了一个涉及毫无价值的铁路股票的骗局。

entries.en: The normally confiding child grew quiet when the stranger approached.
entries.zh: 那个平时容易相信别人的孩子在陌生人靠近时安静了下来。

entries.en: The confined animals paced restlessly behind the fence.
entries.zh: 被关起来的动物在围栏后不安地踱步。

entries.en: A confirmed pessimist, he expected the outing to end in rain.
entries.zh: 他是个根深蒂固的悲观主义者，预料这次出游会以一场雨收场。

entries.en: The confusing signs sent us back to the entrance twice.
entries.zh: 令人困惑的标志让我们两次又绕回入口。

entries.en: The historical case file records the birth of each conjoined twin.
entries.zh: 历史病例档案记录了这对连体婴儿中每个婴儿的出生情况。

entries.en: In the folktale, the magician can conjure up a golden bridge.
entries.zh: 在民间故事中，魔法师能用魔法变出一座金桥。

entries.en: The final conjuring trick made a silk scarf appear inside the locked box.
entries.zh: 最后一个魔术让一条丝巾出现在上锁的箱子里。

entries.en: The old projector might conk out before the film ends.
entries.zh: 旧放映机可能在电影结束前突然失灵。

entries.en: The connected buildings allow visitors to walk indoors from one gallery to another.
entries.zh: 相连的大楼使访客能在室内从一个展厅走到另一个展厅。

entries.en: The teaching slide shows connective tissue surrounding the muscle fibres.
entries.zh: 教学切片展示了肌肉纤维周围的结缔组织。

entries.en: The archive contains a conscientious objector's account of his tribunal hearing.
entries.zh: 档案中保存着一位因良心原因拒绝服兵役者对其审裁听证的记述。

entries.en: Only consenting participants were included in the recorded interviews.
entries.zh: 只有同意参与的人才被纳入录音访谈。

entries.en: The committee gave a considered response after examining both proposals.
entries.zh: 委员会审查两份提案后作出了经过慎重考虑的答复。

entries.en: The sociologist interpreted the lavish party as conspicuous consumption.
entries.zh: 社会学家把这场奢华聚会解读为炫耀性消费。

entries.en: The fictional case notes describe the patient as constipated.
entries.zh: 虚构病例记录将患者描述为患有便秘。

entries.en: Their constrained conversation ended as soon as the train arrived.
entries.zh: 他们拘束的交谈在火车到站时立即结束了。

entries.en: She searched the bathroom floor for her missing contact lens.
entries.zh: 她在浴室地板上寻找丢失的隐形眼镜。

entries.en: The container ship waited outside the harbour for a pilot.
entries.zh: 集装箱运货船在港外等候引航员。

entries.en: The report maps the contaminated soil around the abandoned factory.
entries.zh: 报告绘图标出了废弃工厂周围受污染的土壤。

entries.en: The cat gave a contented sigh beside the warm stove.
entries.zh: 猫在温暖的炉子旁满足地叹了一口气。

entries.en: The small hotel served a continental breakfast in the courtyard.
entries.zh: 小旅馆在庭院里供应欧式早餐。

entries.en: The geology lesson introduced continental drift with maps from different periods.
entries.zh: 地质课用不同时期的地图介绍了大陆漂移。

entries.en: The research vessel mapped part of the continental shelf.
entries.zh: 考察船测绘了大陆架的一部分。

entries.en: The university's continuing education programme offered evening history classes.
entries.zh: 大学的继续教育项目开设了晚间历史课程。

entries.en: The reviewer called the phrase a contradiction in terms.
entries.zh: 评论者称这个短语是自相矛盾的说法。

entries.en: The film's contrived ending disappointed viewers who liked its realistic opening.
entries.zh: 喜欢影片写实开头的观众对其不自然的结局感到失望。

entries.en: She answered the accusation in a quiet, controlled voice.
entries.zh: 她以平静、克制的声音回应了指责。

entries.en: He packed convenience food for the nights when the kitchen would be closed.
entries.zh: 他带上了方便食品，以备厨房关闭的那些夜晚食用。

entries.en: The convenience store stayed open after the larger shops closed.
entries.zh: 大商店关门后，便利店仍然营业。

entries.en: The conveyor belt carried the sealed boxes toward the loading bay.
entries.zh: 传送带把密封的箱子送向装货区。

entries.en: The witness gave a convincing explanation for the unexpected delay.
entries.zh: 证人对意外延误给出了令人信服的解释。

entries.en: The children tried to cook up an excuse for the broken window.
entries.zh: 孩子们试图为窗户被打破一事编造一个借口。

entries.en: Her interest in cooking began in a tiny neighbourhood restaurant.
entries.zh: 她对烹饪的兴趣始于一家小小的社区餐馆。

entries.en: We left the soup to cool down beside the open window.
entries.zh: 我们把汤放在敞开的窗旁晾凉。

entries.en: The mechanic inspected the cooler before reconnecting the pipes.
entries.zh: 机械师在重新连接管道之前检查了冷却器。

entries.en: The technician recorded the metal's temperature during cooling.
entries.zh: 技术员记录了金属冷却过程中的温度。

entries.en: A thin plume rose above the cooling tower at dawn.
entries.zh: 黎明时，一缕轻烟般的气流在冷却塔上方升起。

entries.en: The maritime painting shows a copper-bottomed ship entering the harbour.
entries.zh: 这幅航海画描绘了一艘船底包铜皮的船驶入港口。

entries.en: The grammar exercise asks students to underline the copula in each sentence.
entries.zh: 语法练习要求学生在每句中的系词下划线。

entries.en: The copying of the fragile manuscript took several weeks.
entries.zh: 誊写这份脆弱手稿花了几个星期。

entries.en: The catalogue identifies the copyrighted photographs used in the exhibition.
entries.zh: 目录列明了展览中使用的受版权保护的照片。

entries.en: The divers followed the edge of the coral reef.
entries.zh: 潜水者沿着珊瑚礁的边缘前进。

entries.en: The old memoir describes the medal as a cordon bleu of scholarship.
entries.zh: 这本旧回忆录将该奖章描述为学术上的崇高荣誉。

entries.en: The workers will cordon off the damaged pavement before repairs begin.
entries.zh: 维修开始前，工人将用警戒线隔离受损的人行道。

entries.en: The empty corn cob rolled beneath the picnic table.
entries.zh: 吃空的玉米穗轴滚到了野餐桌下。

entries.en: The shopkeeper sliced corned beef for the sandwiches.
entries.zh: 店主切了咸牛肉，用来做三明治。

entries.en: The historical medical register includes a case of coronary thrombosis.
entries.zh: 历史医学登记册中有一例冠状动脉血栓形成的记录。

entries.en: The history seminar examined arguments against corporal punishment in prisons.
entries.zh: 历史研讨课分析了反对在监狱中实行体罚的论点。

entries.en: Each diagram has a corresponding explanation on the opposite page.
entries.zh: 每幅图在对页都有相应的说明。

entries.en: The corroded pipe broke when the worker tried to move it.
entries.zh: 工人试图移动这根已被腐蚀的管子时，管子断了。

entries.en: The shed's corrugated roof rattled in the strong wind.
entries.zh: 棚屋的波状屋顶在强风中咯咯作响。

entries.en: The medical archive includes photographs documenting cosmetic surgery to lift facial skin.
entries.zh: 医学档案中有记录面部皮肤提升整容手术的照片。

entries.en: The factory introduced cost accounting to compare its production lines.
entries.zh: 工厂引入成本核算，以比较各条生产线。

entries.en: The contract used a cost-plus arrangement for the restoration work.
entries.zh: 合同对修复工程采用了照本加成的计价安排。

entries.en: The manager requested detailed costing before approving the new packaging.
entries.zh: 经理要求先进行详细成本计算，再批准新包装。

entries.en: The historical paediatrics index contains a section on cot death.
entries.zh: 历史儿科学索引中有一个关于婴儿卧床猝死的部分。

entries.en: She spooned cottage cheese onto the sliced tomatoes.
entries.zh: 她用勺子把软白干酪舀到番茄片上。

entries.en: The family shared a cottage pie after the long walk.
entries.zh: 长途步行后，一家人分吃了一份上铺土豆泥的肉饼。

entries.en: A child carried pink cotton candy through the fairground.
entries.zh: 一个孩子拿着粉色棉花糖穿过游乐场。

entries.meaningZh: 花大量时间看电视的人
entries.en: He jokingly called himself a couch potato after watching television all weekend.
entries.zh: 整个周末都在看电视后，他开玩笑地说自己是个电视迷。

entries.en: In the novel, the exhausted traveller pauses to cough up phlegm.
entries.zh: 在小说中，疲惫的旅行者停下来咳痰。

entries.en: The college offered counselling to students deciding which courses to take.
entries.zh: 学院向正在决定选哪些课程的学生提供指导。

entries.en: The dictionary gives the plural form beside each count noun.
entries.zh: 词典在每个可数名词旁标出复数形式。

entries.en: The editorial drew an angry counterblast from the factory owners.
entries.zh: 这篇社论引来了工厂主们愤怒而强硬的抗议。

entries.en: The children's counting stopped when the lights went out.
entries.zh: 灯灭时，孩子们停止了计数。

entries.en: The village hall hosted country dancing on Saturday evenings.
entries.zh: 村会堂每周六晚举行乡村舞活动。

entries.en: The historical novel ends the duel with a swift coup de grace.
entries.zh: 这部历史小说以迅速的致命一击结束了这场决斗。

entries.en: The courtier waited outside the queen's private chamber.
entries.zh: 侍臣在女王的私人房间外等候。

entries.en: We waited for the rain to stop beneath the covered walkway.
entries.zh: 我们在有顶的走道下等雨停。

entries.en: The museum displayed a covered wagon beside a map of western trails.
entries.zh: 博物馆在一张西部道路地图旁展出了一辆有篷马车。

entries.en: A thick covering of leaves hid the broken steps.
entries.zh: 厚厚的落叶覆盖物遮住了破损的台阶。

entries.en: She attached a covering letter explaining the enclosed photographs.
entries.zh: 她附上一封说明所附照片的伴书。

entries.en: The public health archive includes a report on crack cocaine.
entries.zh: 公共卫生档案中有一份关于强效可卡因的报告。

entries.en: The council promised to crack down on illegal dumping.
entries.zh: 市政委员会承诺采取严厉措施打击非法倾倒垃圾。

entries.en: The climber's cracked hands stung in the cold air.
entries.zh: 登山者皲裂的双手在冷空气中刺痛。

entries.en: The reviewer praised the cast for a cracking performance.
entries.zh: 评论者称赞演员们奉献了一场精彩的表演。

entries.en: We bought a handmade bowl at the craft fair.
entries.zh: 我们在手工艺品展览会上买了一只手工碗。

entries.en: The cramped office had barely enough space for two desks.
entries.zh: 这间狭窄的办公室勉强放得下两张书桌。

entries.en: The mechanic tried to crank up the old engine.
entries.zh: 机械师试图用曲柄开动这台旧发动机。

entries.en: The workers replaced a damaged section of crash barrier.
entries.zh: 工人们更换了一段损坏的防撞护栏。

entries.en: The rider fastened his crash helmet before starting the motorcycle.
entries.zh: 骑手在启动摩托车前系好了安全头盔。

entries.en: The smell of fresh bread gave her a craving for warm toast.
entries.zh: 新鲜面包的气味让她渴望吃到热吐司。

entries.en: In the thriller, a crazed pursuer follows the hero through the abandoned station.
entries.zh: 在这部惊悚小说中，一个疯狂的追赶者跟着主人公穿过废弃车站。

entries.en: He spread cream cheese over the warm bagel.
entries.zh: 他把奶油干酪涂在热贝果上。

entries.en: After days on the road, the travellers welcomed creature comforts such as hot meals and clean clothes.
entries.zh: 奔波多日后，旅行者们很欢迎热饭和干净衣服这样的衣食享受。

entries.en: The fictional case compares the firm's credit rating before and after the merger.
entries.zh: 虚构案例比较了这家公司合并前后的信用评价。

entries.en: The scene gave her a creepy-crawly feeling along her arms.
entries.zh: 这个场景让她手臂上产生一种毛骨悚然的感觉。

entries.en: A crested bird landed on the garden wall.
entries.zh: 一只有冠毛的鸟落在了花园墙上。

entries.en: The historical report discusses how crib death was recorded in older registers.
entries.zh: 历史报告讨论了旧登记册如何记录婴儿猝死综合征。

entries.en: The journalist waited outside the criminal court for the verdict.
entries.zh: 记者在刑事法庭外等候裁决。

entries.en: The narrator sees the villain's apology as nothing but crocodile tears.
entries.zh: 叙述者认为反派的道歉不过是鳄鱼的眼泪。

entries.en: A crooked lane led from the harbour to the hillside cottages.
entries.zh: 一条弯曲的小巷从港口通向山坡上的小屋。

entries.en: Small errors tend to crop up when the team works too quickly.
entries.zh: 团队工作过快时，小错误往往会突然出现。

entries.en: The archivist will cross-check the dates against the original letters.
entries.zh: 档案员将对照原信反复核对日期。

entries.en: The project compares greetings in a cross-cultural study of workplace communication.
entries.zh: 这个项目通过一项跨文化的职场沟通研究比较问候方式。

entries.en: The theatre history essay explores why performers would cross-dress on stage.
entries.zh: 戏剧史文章探讨了演员为何会在舞台上穿着异性服装。

entries.en: During cross-examination, the witness corrected the time given in his earlier statement.
entries.zh: 在交叉盘问中，证人更正了先前陈述中的时间。

entries.en: The historical portrait shows a cross-eyed sitter looking toward the artist.
entries.zh: 这幅历史肖像描绘了一位斜视的模特望向画家。

entries.en: The lawyer's first cross-question concerned the witness's distance from the doorway.
entries.zh: 律师交叉盘问的第一个问题涉及证人离门口的距离。

entries.en: A cross-reference directed the reader to the earlier diagram.
entries.zh: 一处交叉引用将读者引向前面的图表。

entries.en: She decorated the cushion with red cross-stitch.
entries.zh: 她用红色十字绣装饰了靠垫。

entries.en: The old label showed crossbones beneath a dark skull.
entries.zh: 旧标签在深色骷髅下方画着交叉的股骨图形。

entries.en: The ferry crossing took longer because of the strong current.
entries.zh: 由于水流湍急，渡轮横渡花了更长时间。

entries.en: His crow's feet deepened when he laughed at the photograph.
entries.zh: 他看着照片发笑时，眼角的鱼尾纹加深了。

entries.en: The sailor climbed to the crow's nest to watch for land.
entries.zh: 水手爬上桅顶岗亭，眺望陆地。

entries.en: The crowded platform became quieter after the express train left.
entries.zh: 快车驶离后，拥挤的站台安静了一些。

entries.en: The museum displayed the crown jewel under carefully controlled lighting.
entries.zh: 博物馆在精心控制的灯光下展出了御宝。

entries.en: The military museum displays a disarmed cruise missile.
entries.zh: 军事博物馆展出了一枚已解除武装的巡航导弹。

entries.en: The cruise ship anchored beyond the fishing boats.
entries.zh: 大型游轮在渔船外侧下了锚。

entries.en: The team suffered a crushing defeat in the final match.
entries.zh: 球队在决赛中遭到惨败。

entries.en: The mud-crusted boots stood beside the kitchen door.
entries.zh: 结着硬泥壳的靴子放在厨房门边。

entries.en: The report highlighted a crying need for repairs to the village bridge.
entries.zh: 报告强调了修缮村桥的迫切需要。

entries.en: The fortune-teller covered her crystal ball with a dark cloth.
entries.zh: 占卜者用深色布盖住了水晶球。

entries.en: The student examined the crystallized material under a lamp.
entries.zh: 学生在灯下观察了结晶物质。

entries.en: The calculator gave the cube root of the entered number.
entries.zh: 计算器给出了输入数值的立方根。

entries.en: The cuckoo clock interrupted the quiet lesson at noon.
entries.zh: 中午，布谷鸟钟打破了安静的课堂。

entries.en: The cultivated fields ended where the rocky hillside began.
entries.zh: 耕地在多石山坡开始的地方结束了。

entries.en: The cultured host discussed paintings without making the visitors feel ignorant.
entries.zh: 有修养的主人谈论绘画，却不让访客觉得自己无知。

entries.en: The advertisement presented the bottled mixture as a cure-all.
entries.zh: 广告把瓶装混合液宣传成了万灵药。

entries.en: The kitten likes to curl up beside the warm radiator.
entries.zh: 小猫喜欢在暖气片旁蜷起身体。

entries.en: The sample balance sheet lists cash among the company's current assets.
entries.zh: 示例资产负债表将现金列在公司的流动资产中。

entries.en: She revised her curriculum vitae before applying for the research position.
entries.zh: 申请研究职位前，她修改了履历。

entries.en: The cook added curry powder to the simmering lentils.
entries.zh: 厨师在炖煮的扁豆中加了咖喱粉。

entries.en: In the sermon, the cursed souls fear eternal punishment.
entries.zh: 在布道词中，被诅咒的灵魂畏惧永恒的惩罚。

entries.en: The curtained window let only a narrow strip of sunlight through.
entries.zh: 挂着帘子的窗户只透进一条窄窄的阳光。

entries.en: A curved path leads around the old oak tree.
entries.zh: 一条弯曲的小路绕着老橡树延伸。

entries.en: The comedian ducked as the custard pie flew toward him.
entries.zh: 蛋奶馅饼道具朝他飞来时，喜剧演员低头躲闪。
